llmnav-catalog/1 repository=relaydock catalog=relaydock.migration
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.migration.expert-durability.down
role Remove expert durability indexes, lease metadata, tenant scope, and result linkage introduced by migration 000002.
owns expert durability rollback, consultation lease column removal
excludes initial expert tables, stored result payloads
invariant Foreign-key and check constraints are removed before their owned columns. The initial consultation and ContextPack tables remain available after rollback.

@relaydock.migration.expert-durability.up
role Add tenant scope, fenced worker lease state, result provenance, and claim indexes to durable expert consultations.
owns expert lease schema, expert tenant scope, consultation result linkage
excludes consultation transition code, worker retry policy
invariant Consultation attempt counts cannot become negative. Queued and stale-running consultations have separate partial indexes for worker recovery.

@relaydock.migration.initial.down
role Remove every application schema created by the initial RelayDock migration during an explicit full rollback.
owns initial schema rollback, application schema removal
excludes public migration ledger, database backup
invariant Rollback removes outbox, expert, runtime, and control schemas as one ordered migration step. The public schema and migration runner ledger remain outside this rollback file.

@relaydock.migration.initial.up
role Create the initial control, runtime, expert, and outbox PostgreSQL schemas and their foundational integrity constraints.
owns initial database schema, initial runtime ledgers, initial queue indexes
excludes later lease durability columns, migration execution
invariant Usage events remain separate from request and provider-attempt records. Consultation idempotency is unique within each project.

@relaydock.migration.outbox-delivery.down
role Remove recoverable lease and dead-letter state while restoring the initial pending-event queue index.
owns outbox delivery rollback, initial queue index restoration
excludes outbox event deletion, published event cleanup
invariant Delivery-specific indexes are removed before their backing columns. The restored queue index continues to exclude published events.

@relaydock.migration.outbox-delivery.up
role Add recoverable outbox lease expiry, bounded failure state, dead-letter state, and worker-oriented partial indexes.
owns outbox delivery schema, outbox lease recovery index, dead-letter persistence
excludes delivery retry algorithm, event publisher
invariant An event cannot be both published and dead-lettered. Claim and stale-lock indexes exclude terminal events.

@relaydock.migration.runtime-journal.down
role Remove expanded request usage and provider-attempt journal fields while restoring the original connection requirement when data permits.
owns runtime journal rollback, provider connection constraint restoration
excludes request row deletion, usage event rollback
invariant The NOT NULL provider connection constraint is restored only when no existing attempt contains NULL. Base request and provider-attempt records survive the rollback.

@relaydock.migration.runtime-journal.up
role Expand the runtime journal with client identity, tenant scope, usage totals, provider attempt provenance, commit state, and bounded failure metadata.
owns runtime journal schema, provider attempt provenance, request usage totals
excludes journal write sequencing, usage settlement
invariant Attempt and token counters remain non-negative. Provider attempts may omit a control-plane connection when signed snapshots supply the route.
